name: WhatsApp Business
description: Business messaging platform; the Meta-hosted WhatsApp Cloud API (Graph API) sends/receives WhatsApp messages, templates and media for businesses.
access_notes: Any Meta developer can self-serve a test WABA + test phone number and a temporary (~24h) access token, and message up to a handful of opted-in test recipients for free. Production requires a permanent System User token from Business Settings, a published app, a dedicated registered business phone number, and Meta business verification to scale past the base messaging tier; conversations/messages are billed.
mcp_notes: Composio catalog lists a WhatsApp toolkit (WHATSAPP, 57 tools, OAUTH2/API_KEY, triggers). No official Meta/WhatsApp MCP server found in Meta developer docs during research.
uncertainty_notes: OAuth2 (Facebook Login for Business / Embedded Signup) is the flow Meta pushes for multi-tenant Tech Provider integrations; single-business integrations typically use long-lived System User bearer tokens. API breadth is deep for messaging (messages, templates, media, phone numbers, WABA management) but centered on the messaging use case, hence medium.

evidence.note: Self-serve: create Meta app, generate temporary access token, send test message from test number; permanent token requires a System User in Business Settings with whatsapp_business_messaging/management permissions.
Cloud API uses 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'; temporary token expires <24h, System User token is the permanent credential.
Test WABA/test number from get-started; API Setup panel adds a production business phone number; business_verification_status tracked on the WABA.
Catalog lists WhatsApp toolkit (WHATSAPP, 57 tools, OAUTH2/API_KEY).
